messages:
IncidentBot: 🚨 ALERT: High error rate (502/503) and frequent websocket disconnects for tenant 'NovaBank' through the Enterprise VPC Gateway (us-east-1). Impact: streaming sessions failing to establish or dropping after ~30-90s. Auto-page on-call.

Jonah Kim: oncall here. seeing the PD page. joining. any customer context?

Sasha Li: I'm on it. quick snapshot: 5xx ratio from gateway -> app-gw is spiking to ~18% over last 5m. TCP-level retransmits look fine. WS handshake logs show lots of 101 then immediate 200-range error frames (app-level). suspect gateway -> customer app is returning intermittent HTTP 504s and the client-sdk is retrying aggressively.

Maya Patel: reported by NovaBank SREs 5m ago that they deployed a canary of new autoscaler on their app-gw, might be related. They say they're seeing connection churn but no obvious CPU/memory pressure in their infra yet. Priya FYI (acct exec).

Priya Rao: @Maya thanks. I'm pinging the customer slack and putting them in the loop — will tell them we have an engineer on it and we may do a short mitigation.

Sasha Li: findings so far from gateway logs:
```
2026-03-15T21:02:12Z ws: conn_id=abc123 tenant=novabank upstream=10.7.3.8:443 status=101 accepted
2026-03-15T21:02:45Z ws: conn_id=abc123 tenant=novabank upstream=10.7.3.8:443 status=502 read_timeout
2026-03-15T21:03:02Z ws: conn_id=def456 tenant=novabank upstream=10.7.3.9:443 status=101 accepted
2026-03-15T21:03:35Z proxy: session_id=def456 client_retries=3 upstream=10.7.3.9:443 error=upstream_gone
```
Looks like two upstream backends flapped. The client retries are leading to bursty reconnects. When retries pile up, our routing threads for that tenant hit queue wait time and we start returning 5xx to new connects.

Jonah Kim: is tenant isolation behaving (dedicated pools)? This tenant is on a dedicated pool, right?

Sasha Li: Yes, NovaBank is on Dedicated-Pool-7 in us-east-1. The pool is healthy in terms of GPU/CPU but network egress to their app-gw shows intermittent TLS timeouts. So it's not resource isolation failure; it's connectivity instability upstream.

Maya Patel: immediate mitigation ideas:
- apply per-tenant backoff to reduce client-sdk storming (short term)
- route NovaBank to the fallback long-lived HTTP SSE endpoint instead of WS for 5-10m to reduce handshake overhead
- temporarily increase gateway upstream timeout from 30s -> 90s for this tenant
- ask DeployBot to apply a routing override to send traffic to a compatibility proxy that retries less agressively
Which should we do now?

OpsPager: Pager duty trigger acknowledged by Sasha Li. Escalation path: if not resolved in 20m escalate to oncall-2.

Sasha Li: I prefer increasing upstream timeout + per-tenant backoff first (low-risk). If insufficient, switch to SSE fallback and reduce new WS accepts.

Jonah Kim: agree. Sasha, can you push the per-tenant policy and timeout change? I'll stand by to run the routing override if needed.

Sasha Li: doing the change now. patching tenant policy:
```
# tenant config snippet
tenant: novabank
ws: {
  upstream_timeout: 90s
  connect_retries: 2
  retry_backoff_ms: 800
  max_open_per_second: 50
}
```
Applying...

DeployBot: started apply to routing-configs/tenants/novabank at commit sha abcdef123.

Sasha Li: applied. logs show config reload success. Observability: adding a soft throttle on new WS handshake rate for tenant to 50/s.

Maya Patel: I'm drafting a short message to the customer: "we observed upstream instability; we've applied temporary timeout and handshake pacing while we continue to investigate. If you prefer, we can flip to an SSE fallback — this will preserve streaming but change reconnection semantics." Priya, can you send?

Priya Rao: sending now to NovaBank-SRE: "We're seeing intermittent timeouts between Redwood Enterprise Gateway and your app gateway. We've applied temporary gateway-level timeouts and handshake pacing. Please confirm if you want us to enable SSE fallback. We'll keep you updated every 10m."

NovaBank-SRE (via external): Thanks, please enable SSE fallback — our team can handle the different pattern. We also opened a ticket to check their load-balancer health.

Jonah Kim: ok SSE fallback approved by customer. Sasha — prepare switch. We should also keep Dedicated-Pool-7 in write-protected mode (no rollout) while we stabilize.

Sasha Li: preparing SSE toggle. config change:
```
route: novabank
preferred_streaming: sse
sse: {
  keepalive: 60s
  reconnect_jitter: 250ms
}
```
I'll also pin Dedicated-Pool-7 and disable autoscaling for the next 30m.

DeployBot: apply started for routing-configs/fallbacks/novabank -> enabling SSE fallback.

DeployBot: apply succeeded.

Sasha Li: SSE enabled. Early metrics: handshake failures down from 18% -> 4% over the last 3m. Upstream 5xx rate also trending down but still noisy.

Maya Patel: great. Priya — can you confirm customer sees better behavior? Also capture any user-facing impact numbers for postmortem.

Priya Rao: NovaBank: "connections stable, some client SDK logs show fewer disconnects. Thanks." I'll open a JIRA with the account tags and link to this thread.

Jonah Kim: next: primary followups for postmortem:
- root cause with NovaBank SRE (LB canary)
- evaluate whether our per-tenant circuit-breaker thresholds are too permissive
- add synthetic tests for upstream TLS stability per tenant (us-east-1)
- decide whether SSE fallback should be opt-in or automatic for some failure modes

Sasha Li: onboarding notes: I'll keep the per-tenant backoff for 40m then revert to defaults if stable. I'll also keep Dedicated-Pool-7 pinned for 60m.

Maya Patel: Pager note: reduced customer impact. will update incident severity to SEV-2 -> SEV-3 if trend keeps.

OpsPager: escalation cleared. No further escalation unless metrics worsen.

Jonah Kim: handing off to night oncall Dave Chen for monitoring + followups. Dave — I'll DM you the pinned links.

Dave Chen: taking over. I'll monitor dashboards and confirm reversion plan at +40m. If we see >5% 5xx again, I'll re-open pager and revert routing changes.

Maya Patel: thanks all. final public notes for timeline and impact will go into postmortem doc.

IncidentBot: incident updated: status=mitigated, mitigations=per-tenant backoff,timed upstream timeout increase,SSE fallback enabled, owner=Dave Chen.

Dave Chen: copying final checklist I'll follow: [1] monitor 5xx & handshake failure windows (5m/15m), [2] coordinate with NovaBank SRE for LB rollback plan, [3] prepare postmortem draft + customer summary. I'll close thread when done.

Jonah Kim: thanks — great low-risk mitigation sequence.

Dave Chen: closing note: metrics stable at T+35m, leaving SSE fallback enabled for 2h as safety window. Will revert to WS if NovaBank confirms LB fix.

Maya Patel: documented in incident tracker and linked to customer JIRA.

IncidentBot: incident closed by Dave Chen at 2798766800."
